legal.draft: Draft for review: placeholders in [brackets] are the owner's to fill in, and the final text needs a legal review before launch.

s1.p: Globetrot is a trip-planning app run by [owner: legal name and country]. Contact: [owner: contact email].

s2.p: Your account (name, email, a hash of your password, or your Google sign-in), your settings, and what you put in Globetrot: trips, stops, costs, savings amounts, lists, day plans, photos, visas, Pip requests and community posts, comments and likes. We do not collect your live location. Photos have their location and camera data removed before they are stored.

s3.p: To run the app you asked for: save and show your plans, compute your savings answer, send account emails (confirmation, password reset and the two emails about your free week), and keep the service safe (rate limits, an audit log of changes without personal values).

s4.p: Hosting and database: [owner: provider and region]. Email: [owner: provider]. Photo storage: [owner: provider]. Pip: when you ask Pip, the plan of that trip (title, dates, stops, nights, places, checklist labels, cost totals and savings amounts) is sent to DeepSeek to draft suggestions; never your name, email or other trips. Sign in with Google, if you use it. Measurement: Plausible (cookieless, aggregate) and, only if you accept, the Meta Pixel. Payments: Stripe, which receives your email and handles your card; we never see card numbers.

s5.p: Needed: your session, your language and theme, and, if you used the calculator on the home page, the three numbers you typed (30 days). Optional: the Meta Pixel, only after you accept; change your choice any time from “Cookie preferences” on the home page.

s6.p: Trips are private. Community posts are seen by everyone or only your followers, as you choose; your name, handle and Pip are shown with them. A shared route is a copy of the stops and nights at that moment, without amounts unless you chose to show them. A trip you share by link can be opened by anyone with that link: its title, stops, countries, nights, the month you leave and how far your savings are, and amounts only if you choose. Never your name or exact dates. Stopping the share ends the link for good.

s7.p: Until you delete it, or delete your account. Deleting the account removes your trips, photos, posts, comments, likes, follows, settings and sessions at once. The audit log keeps its rows, which hold no personal values. Backups: [owner: retention period].

s8.p: Download everything as JSON or delete your account in Settings → Your data. For anything else (correction, objection, questions) write to [owner: contact email]. You can also complain to your data protection authority (in Brazil, the ANPD).

s9.p: Globetrot is not meant for children under [owner: minimum age].

s10.p: We will say here, with a date, when this policy changes. Last change: [owner: date].

s1.p: Globetrot helps you plan trips: a map, days, a budget with a savings answer, lists, a passport of keepsake visas, an optional AI companion (Pip) and a community. It is offered by [owner: legal name]. Using it means you accept these terms.

s2.p: Every account starts with a 7-day free trial with no card. After it, paid plans (Explorer and Voyager) are billed monthly or yearly by our payment provider; you can cancel at any time and keep your plan until the end of the period paid. Without a plan the account becomes read-only: you can still see, export and delete your data. Extra Pip credits never expire. [owner: refund policy and the payment provider’s terms]

s3.p: Globetrot never books, sells or holds money. Costs are what you type; estimates are labelled ≈ and are not quotes. Pip’s suggestions are drafts you review; they can be wrong. Always check prices, availability and entry or visa rules on official sources. Globetrot visas and stamps are keepsakes, not documents.

s4.p: Keep your password safe; you are responsible for what happens in your account. One person per account. You can delete it at any time in Settings.

s5.p: What you post stays yours. By posting in the community you let us show it to the audience you chose, and to copy a shared route into someone’s trip when they ask. Do not post what you have no right to share, other people’s private data or live location, hate, harassment, spam or anything illegal. We may hide or remove such content and close accounts that break these rules.

s6.p: We work to keep Globetrot running and your data safe, but the service is provided as it is, without guarantees of uninterrupted availability. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses or for decisions you make from the app’s estimates.

s7.p: We may update these terms; we will say so here with a date. These terms are governed by [owner: governing law and venue]. Contact: [owner: contact email].

landing.faq1Q: Does Globetrot hold or move my money?
landing.faq1A: No. Savings are a record you keep. Globetrot never holds funds and never charges for a trip.
landing.faq2A: No. Costs are what you type, and estimates are marked ≈ and labelled as typical ranges, never live quotes.
landing.faq3Q: Is the passport an official document?
landing.faq3A: No. Globetrot visas and stamps are keepsakes for your trips. Always check entry rules on official sites.
landing.faq4Q: Do I have to use Pip or AI?
landing.faq4A: No. Pip is optional. Every feature works by hand, and Pip only proposes changes you approve.
landing.footTagline: Plan the trip on a map. Know when you can go.
landing.metaHeadline: Plan the trip on a map. Know when you can go.
landing.ogAnswer: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} at {monthly} a month.
landing.fact5Body: Private trips. Export or delete anytime.
landing.closeTitle: Your next trip has a date. Find it.
landing.closeBody: Pin the route, add what it costs, and see the month you can go. It takes a few minutes.
landing.faq5A: The first {days} days are free with everything included and no card. Then Explorer is {explorerMonthly} a month ({explorerAnnual} a year) and Voyager {voyagerMonthly} a month ({voyagerAnnual} a year). If you don’t choose a plan, your trips stay yours to see and export.
landing.faq6A: Yes. Trips are private by default and nobody else can open them. In Settings you can download all your data or delete your account at any time.
landing.faq7Q: Does it work on my phone, in my currency?
landing.faq7A: Yes. Globetrot runs in the browser on phones and computers, in English or Portuguese, with costs in any currency. The default is USD, never guessed from your language or country.
landing.faq8Q: Do I need to install anything?
landing.faq8A: No. Create an account with your email and start in the browser. Nothing to download.
